issue.title: Bug:Route Not Installed in FIB After Connected Route Deletion

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

When a route prefix is programmed in the RIB by both a connected route and a static route, the connected route is preferred by the RIB and installed in the FIB. After the connected route is deleted, the RIB correctly selects the static route; however, the static route is not installed in the FIB.

### Steps to Reproduce

-Configure Ethernet264 with IP <IP>/24 (creates connected route for <IP>/24)
sudo config interface ip add Ethernet264 <IP>/24

-Configure Ethernet268 with IP <IP>/24 (for static route next-hop)
sudo config interface ip add Ethernet4 <IP>/24

-Bring up both interfaces
sudo config interface startup Ethernet264
sudo config interface startup Ethernet268

-Add static route for <IP>/24 via <IP>
sudo config route add prefix <IP>/24 nexthop <IP>

sudo config interface shutdown Ethernet264

Static route <IP>/24 via <IP> is not installed in FIB.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior: Static route <IP>/24 via <IP> is not installed in FIB.
Expected Behavior:  Static route <IP>/24 via <IP> is expected to be installed in FIB.

### Relevant log output

```shell
The prefix affected by the issue is <IP>/24. After triggering an interface shutdown, the connected route is removed and an update for the <IP>/24 prefix is sent. The prefix is subsequently deleted upon the next update from the MRIB.

2026-01-23 <IPV6>.078 [DEBG] zebra: [W3XNK-8CC35] rib_meta_queue_add: (default:254):<IP>/24: queued rn 0x558fb5042060 into sub-queue Connected Routes mq size 8
2026-01-23 <IPV6>.087 [DEBG] zebra: [PM9ZJ-07RCP] 0:<IP>/24 Dplane route update ctx 0x558fb507a220 op ROUTE_UPDAT
2026-01-23 <IPV6>.087 [DEBG] zebra: [GW4S4-NE28R] rib_meta_queue_add: (default:254):<IP>/24: rn 0x558fb5042060 is already queued in sub-queue Connected Routes
2026-01-23 <IPV6>.087 [DEBG] zebra: [W3XNK-8CC35] rib_meta_queue_add: (default:254):<IP>/24 (MRIB): queued rn 0x558fb4bbfea0 into sub-queue Connected Routes mq size 9
2026-01-23 <IPV6>.087 [DEBG] zebra: [GW4S4-NE28R] rib_meta_queue_add: (default:254):<IP>/24: rn 0x558fb5042060 is already queued in sub-queue Connected Routes
2026-01-23 <IPV6>.088 [DEBG] zebra: [PM9ZJ-07RCP] 0:<IP>/24 Dplane route update ctx 0x558fb5081b00 op ROUTE_DELET
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell
SONiC OS Version: 12 (202505)
FRRouting (version 10.3)
```

### Attach files (if any)

[RouteUpdateIssue.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24812731/RouteUpdateIssue.txt)

This issue is likely introduced by the commit https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/commit/3bff65abc75e952a15b98666e7271189ac28a2bc in FRR.
Prior to this commit, routes from MRIB were blocked from flowing through the dataplane, which resulted in:
   Routes never being marked as installed
   MRIB nexthop tracking (NHT) not functioning for routes learned after the tracking request

The commit changed behavior by allowing MRIB routes to flow through the dataplane pipeline, but they are not sent to:
   Linux kernel
   FPM (Forwarding Plane Manager)

The commit modified upstream FRR’s dplane_fpm_nl.c to filter routes from MRIB. SONiC uses dplane_fpm_sonic.c, and this filter was not added there.

Fix: Skipping routes from MRIB in dplane_fpm_sonic.c resolves the issue.

Is this a known issue OR is there an open PR addressing it?

resolution.title: [dplane_fpm_sonic]: Skip MRIB routes to prevent FIB route deletion
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/25173

FRR commit https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/commit/3bff65abc75e952a15b98666e7271189ac28a2bc changed behavior to allow MRIB routes through the dataplane pipeline, and upstream's `dplane_fpm_nl.c` was updated to filter them (See this [permalink](https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/blob/7d94895937ce058c654ef27ea39dd1bd55d75844/zebra/dplane_fpm_nl.c#L1785-L1806)). SONiC's `dplane_fpm_sonic.c` was not updated with the same filter, so MRIB ROUTE_DELETE events reach fpmsyncd and delete valid unicast routes from APP_DB.

#### How I did it

Added a `SAFI_MULTICAST` check in `fpm_nl_process()` within `dplane_fpm_sonic.c`, mirroring the upstream FRR fix in `dplane_fpm_nl.c`. Route operations (`ROUTE_DELETE`, `ROUTE_INSTALL`, `ROUTE_UPDATE`) with `SAFI_MULTICAST` are skipped and not enqueued to fpmsyncd.

#### How to verify it

See https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/25173#issuecomment-4186559462 for issue replication instructions. After the fix, `show ip fib` should not miss `<IP>/24`.

#### Description for the changelog

Skip MRIB routes in dplane_fpm_sonic to prevent FIB route deletion when connected routes are withdrawn.
